branches.name: Nature and the economy: foundations
branches.why: the course needs basic framing terms (environment, degradation, human impact) before the economics

branches.name: Microeconomics: consumer choice and value
branches.why: core consumer theory every later valuation and welfare idea relies on

branches.name: Supply, demand and markets
branches.why: price theory: demand and supply curves, elasticities, incidence, equilibrium

branches.name: Producer theory and market structure
branches.chapter: new: Firms, costs and market structure
branches.why: production, cost curves and market structure (oligopoly, monopsony, natural monopoly) have no chapter; needed for abatement costs, energy and resource markets

branches.name: Welfare economics
branches.why: welfare theorems, compensation tests, social choice and second best underpin all policy evaluation

branches.name: Externalities, Pigou and Coase
branches.why: the central theory of environmental economics (social cost, internalization, bargaining, liability) needs its own teaching chapter

branches.name: Information, incentives and contracts
branches.why: asymmetric information, principal-agent and mechanism design underlie PES, offsets, enforcement and regulation design

branches.name: Public goods and property
branches.why: public good provision theory (Samuelson, Lindahl) and property regimes

branches.name: Time, risk and discounting
branches.why: intertemporal choice, Ramsey discounting, expected utility and option value

branches.name: Macroeconomics and national accounts
branches.why: national accounting, capital stocks and macro basics needed for green accounting and climate policy

branches.name: Behavioral economics
branches.why: behavioral anomalies that matter for valuation and environmental behavior

branches.name: Game theory and strategic interaction
branches.chapter: new: Strategic interaction and game theory
branches.why: game theory is needed for commons, international agreements and climate clubs; only two seed pages exist

branches.name: Money, finance and investment basics
branches.why: basic finance (bonds, markets, risk, return) needed before green finance and conservation finance

branches.name: Econometrics and causal inference
branches.why: valuation, impact evaluation of PES and protected areas and climate econometrics all need regression and causal inference

branches.name: Mathematical tools for economics
branches.why: constrained optimization and optimal control are required for resource economics and IAMs

branches.name: Ecosystem structure and function
branches.why: basic ecology vocabulary (producers, consumers, succession, interactions)

branches.name: Population and community ecology
branches.why: population growth models (logistic, Lotka-Volterra, Allee) are the biological core of fisheries and wildlife economics

branches.name: Biogeochemical cycles
branches.why: nutrient, carbon and hydrological processes behind regulating services

branches.name: Biodiversity science and loss
branches.why: measures of biodiversity, extinction dynamics and biodiversity-function links

branches.name: Resilience and complex systems
branches.why: alternative stable states, social-ecological systems and panarchy

branches.name: Ecosystem types
branches.why: major biomes and aquatic systems missing from the key ecosystems list
